decisions.title: One project with two internal tracks
decisions.context: The five-member group needs one coherent Senior Project while supporting research and product responsibilities
decisions.decision: Use one title and one project plan, with Research and Innovation as coordinated internal tracks
decisions.rationale: The model, Clinical Front Door, data, contracts, evaluation, and final demonstration are interdependent
consequences: One official schedule and integration gate
Both tracks share contracts and final evidence

decisions.title: Approximately 4B flagship and gated 27B stretch
decisions.context: The project needs a credible open-weight flagship target without letting scale replace architecture evidence
decisions.decision: Target approximately 4B as flagship and allow 27B only after the 4B release candidate passes every gate
decisions.rationale: Small and 4B evidence is feasible and academically stronger than premature 27B resource commitment
alternatives: Use only a small prototype with no flagship target
consequences: 27B is not on the critical path
Tier 4 approval and G0-G5 evidence are required before 4B training

decisions.title: Stable Model Gateway for provider replacement
decisions.context: Innovation must progress before the team model is complete without becoming coupled to an external provider
decisions.decision: Route mock, external prototype, baseline, and team model providers through one versioned Model API Contract
decisions.rationale: Provider replacement becomes a configuration and adapter change rather than a client rewrite
alternatives: Integrate each provider directly into the client
consequences: Every adapter passes identical contract fixtures

decisions.title: Patient-level splitting and temporal availability
decisions.context: Medical journeys contain correlated encounters and future outcomes that can silently leak into earlier decisions
decisions.decision: Split by stable patient identity before derivation and require available_at_time for all evidence and labels
decisions.rationale: This prevents cross-split identity leakage and future-evidence inflation
alternatives: Use chart-final fields at every snapshot
consequences: Temporal audits are mandatory before training and evaluation

decisions.title: Supervised decision support only
decisions.context: The prototype operates in a safety-critical clinical domain without deployment-grade validation
decisions.decision: Require human confirmation and prohibit autonomous diagnosis, treatment, referral, prescribing, discharge, or care action
decisions.rationale: The academic prototype must preserve human authority and avoid unsupported clinical claims
consequences: Human review is required in the API and workflow

decisions.title: Restrict non-synthetic patient data from external APIs
decisions.context: External providers may retain or process data under terms that differ from dataset and ethics authorization
decisions.decision: Default to synthetic data and require exact recorded authorization before any real, linkable, de-identified-approved, or restricted patient transfer
decisions.rationale: De-identification or dataset access alone does not authorize vendor transfer
consequences: External adapters need payload policy tests

decisions.title: Immutable Semester 1 official schedule
decisions.context: Internal planning buffers must not overwrite faculty deadlines from the referenced activities PDF
decisions.decision: Lock the supplied Semester 1 dates in the official deadline registry and require a new official source plus human decision for correction
decisions.rationale: Official dates are external constraints while internal review dates are adjustable planning controls
alternatives: Allow the PM agent to reschedule official dates
consequences: Verification compares the registry to canonical dates
The missing local PDF remains a visual-verification action

decisions.title: Planning-system ownership boundary
decisions.context: The GSD toolchain introduced .planning/, creating a second vocabulary for work already tracked in docs/project_management/ and project_state/. MILESTONES.md M8 and MASTER_PLAN.md Phase 6 already disagree on the 4B release-candidate window, and recording one Group Application status required editing five files by hand
decisions.decision: project_state/ and docs/ are the sole authoritative record of deadlines, milestones, tasks, risks, decisions, approvals, contracts, and specifications; .planning/ is a subordinate execution layer owning phase sequencing and per-phase artifacts only, and may reference authoritative identifiers but never hold their status, scope, or definition
decisions.rationale: Authority belongs where enforcement and ownership are. project_state/ and docs/ are covered by harness checks and JSON Schema validation while .planning/ had none, and .planning/ is a third-party format governed by the @opengsd/gsd-core release cycle rather than by this project
alternatives: Make .planning/ authoritative and reduce docs/project_management/ to generated views
Maintain both systems in parallel and synchronize by hand
Remove .planning/ and forgo the GSD phase pipeline
consequences: .planning/README.md states the boundary at the point of use
verify_harness.py enforces phase-dependency resolution, requirement-to-phase mapping, and identifier existence in project_state/
Regenerating or deleting .planning/ must never lose project state
On disagreement project_state/ and docs/ win and the .planning/ artifact is corrected
.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md is a derived index whose entries must cite a source document
